The *Parittārammaṇattika, Hetuduka* is an Abhidhamma text belonging to the *Paṭṭhāna*, the seventh and final treatise of the Pali Abhidhamma Piṭaka [SuttaCentral]. Methodologically situated within the Tikaduka permutations of the *Paṭṭhāna*, it examines conditional relations by synthesizing the triad concerning limited or minor objects (*parittārammaṇattika*) with the dyad concerning roots (*hetuduka*).
